svg.text: Every change is a commit — never kubectl apply
Umbrella chart · tag pinned per overlay
Selects which base packages are on
One namespace per PR or SHA
Dev's only ingress — no public Azure LB
Gateway API CRDs — first in the chain
New external host ⇒ add a ServiceEntry
No waypoint deployed, so no L7 rules
Created and reaped by the ResourceSet
oauth2-proxy front door · off in dev
